senses.gloss:
a. 
__1 Relating to, or seen in, the morning. 
__2 Bright, shining. 
-स्रः 
__1 A ray (of light), beam; सर्वैरुस्रैः समग्रैस्त्वमिव नृपगुणैर्दीप्यते सप्तसप्तिः [[M. 2. 13]]; [[R. 4. 66]]; [[Ki. 5. 31]], 34. शीर्षपुष्पोच्छ्रितैरुस्रैरुत्तंसितशिरोरुहाम्; [[Parṇāl. 4. 36.]] 
__2 A bull; [[Rv. 6. 12. 4.]] 
__3 A god. 
__4 The sun. 
__5 A day. 
__6 The two Aśvinīkumāras; [[Rv. 2. 39. 3.]] 
-स्रा 
__1 Morning, dawn. 
__2 Light; bright sky. 
__3 A cow; स्वयमुस्राश्च दुह्यन्ते [[Mb. 12. 263. 31.]] 
__4 The earth. 
-Comp. 
-धन्वन् a. having a bright bow. -m. N. of Indra. 
-यामन् a. going out early in the morning (as the Aśvins); [[Rv. 7. 74. 1.]]

[अल्पार्थे कन्] 
__1 A small ox; [[Rv. 1. 190. 5.]] 
__2 An old ox. 
-का A cow.

a. Belonging to or coming from, an ox or cow. 
-यः 
__1 An ox. 
__2 A god; 
-या 
__1 A cow. 
__2 Brightness, light. 
__3 A calf. 
__4 Milk.
